description: Source file implementing command graph management and Vulkan command buffer handling for ANGLE's Vulkan renderer, including resource dependencies, command execution, and diagnostics.

classes.name: CommandGraph
classes.description: Manages a directed acyclic graph of command nodes for Vulkan command buffer execution, resource dependencies, and diagnostics.

classes.name: CommandGraphNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the command graph, encapsulating a Vulkan command buffer and its dependencies.

classes.name: CommandGraphResource
classes.description: Represents a resource used within the command graph, managing access and dependencies.

classes.name: SharedGarbage
classes.description: Handles deferred destruction of Vulkan objects with serial-based lifetime management.

methods.name: allocateNode
methods.description: Allocates a new command graph node with a specified function.

methods.name: submitCommands
methods.description: Submits the command graph to Vulkan, executing all nodes respecting dependencies.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the command graph, releasing all nodes and resetting state.

methods.name: beginQuery
methods.description: Adds a begin query node to the command graph.

methods.name: endQuery
methods.description: Adds an end query node to the command graph.

methods.name: writeTimestamp
methods.description: Adds a timestamp write node to the command graph.

methods.name: setFenceSync
methods.description: Adds a fence sync node to the command graph.

methods.name: waitFenceSync
methods.description: Adds a wait fence sync node to the command graph.

methods.name: memoryBarrier
methods.description: Adds a global memory barrier node to the command graph.

methods.name: dumpGraphDotFile
methods.description: Outputs the command graph in DOT format for visualization.
